# URL encoder / decoder

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/url-encoder/

Encode or decode a URL component so spaces and special characters can travel safely within query parameters.

## How to use it

1. Enter a sample value, color, URL or structured input.
2. Choose the required format or options and run the tool.
3. Review the output and copy it into your own workflow.

## Example

Encode a search term containing an ampersand without changing the structure of the surrounding URL.

## Limits and checks

Use this for individual components rather than encoding an entire destination URL indiscriminately. Invalid percent escapes cannot be decoded.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
